**Lunches**
- **Easy Instant Pot lentils:** [Rainbow Plant Life – How to Cook Lentils in the Instant Pot](https://rainbowplantlife.com/how-to-cook-lentils-in-the-instant-pot/). For meal-prep bowls/salads, use **brown or green lentils** (they hold their shape): **1 cup lentils : 1¾ cups water or broth**, High Pressure **6–8 minutes**, then a **10-minute natural release**.
- **Turkey chili:** [Ambitious Kitchen – The Best Healthy Turkey Chili](https://www.ambitiouskitchen.com/seriously-the-best-healthy-turkey-chili/). Vegetables: **yellow onion, garlic, red bell pepper, and sweet corn** (plus tomatoes).

**Feel Good Foodie recipes**
- [Halva](https://feelgoodfoodie.net/recipe/halva/)
- [3-Ingredient Chia Pudding](https://feelgoodfoodie.net/recipe/3-ingredient-chia-pudding/)
- [Pecan Bars](https://feelgoodfoodie.net/recipe/pecan-bars/)

**Best two to prep ahead:** **Chia pudding** (portion into jars; keeps up to 5 days) and **pecan bars** (24 portions; refrigerate 4–5 days or freeze up to 3 months). Halva is also fridge-friendly for about a week, but is more of a candy-project than an everyday prep option.
